title: NAuth Helm chart values
description: Schema for NAuth Helm chart values.

affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling the NAuth operator Pod.

install.description: Install and upgrade NAuth CustomResourceDefinitions as part of this chart release.

keep.description: Keep NAuth CustomResourceDefinitions when this chart release is uninstalled.

extraResources.description: Additional Kubernetes resources to render with the chart. Values are templated before rendering.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full generated resource name. Defaults to `<Release.Name>-<Chart.Name>`.

labels.description: Additional labels to add to templated NAuth chart resources.

pullPolicy.description: Kubernetes image pull policy for the NAuth operator container.

registry.description: Container image registry for the NAuth operator.

repository.description: Container image repository for the NAuth operator.

tag.description: Override the container image tag. Defaults to the chart app version when empty.

livenessProbe.description: Liveness probe for the NAuth operator container.

format.description: Operator log output format. Leave empty to use the operator default. Set to `json` for structured log ingestion. Supported values: `text`, `json`.

enabled.description: Expose controller-runtime Prometheus metrics on `/metrics` for direct scraping or collection through a Prometheus receiver.
Create Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor and PrometheusRule resources. Requires the ServiceMonitor and PrometheusRule CRDs.

nameOverride.description: Override the chart name used in generated resource names.
Override the namespace rendered into namespaced resources. Defaults to the Helm release namespace.

namespaced.description: Limit the operator to the configured namespace instead of watching all namespaces.

clusterRef.description: Operator-level NatsCluster reference. Set `name` to bind the operator to one NATS cluster.

name.description: NatsCluster resource name. Leave empty to disable operator-level binding.

namespace.description: NatsCluster resource namespace. When empty and `name` is set, the chart namespace is used.

optional.description: Whether account-level `spec.natsClusterRef` values may override this operator-level cluster.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for scheduling the NAuth operator Pod.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the NAuth operator Pod.

podLabels.description: Additional labels to add to the NAuth operator Pod.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod security context for the NAuth operator Pod.

readinessProbe.description: Readiness probe for the NAuth operator container.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the NAuth operator container.

securityContext.description: Container security context for the NAuth operator container.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ServiceAccount.

create.description: Create a ServiceAccount for the NAuth operator.

nameOverride.description: Override the ServiceAccount name. Defaults to the generated full name when empty.

terminationGracePeriodSeconds.description: Termination grace period for the NAuth operator Pod, in seconds.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for scheduling the NAuth operator Pod.

volumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the NAuth operator container.

volumes.description: Additional volumes for the NAuth operator Pod.
